305: OpenVela AP侧已经完成以下代码和离线构建基线：
306: 
307: - 精确16 MiB、RW/XN/non-cacheable MPU映射。
308: - `0x60720000..0x609fffff`独立AP PSRAM heap。

314: 本覆盖中的CP `0x7`协议要求request `param3=PM_PSRAM_PROTO_V1`；response `param1`回显
315: ON/OFF state、`param2`返回真实PSRAM driver结果、`param3`回显version。CP BOOT与
316: OpenVela使用独立owner，初始化失败不置owner bit。`0xc`已提供frequency/divider、
317: speed、voltage、CPU power/reset和PSRAM owner只读诊断；device ID和actual capacity
318: 仍未暴露，因此alias probe和整颗器件实板测试仍是容量门禁。AP board必须同步发送
319: V1 version并检查真实ret/version后才能联调；本CP侧任务未修改AP board代码。

321: PWC ready 使用两阶段契约：AP 的既有 `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD=0x5` 仅解除 CP boot
322: worker 等待，不发布最终 PWC/bridge ready。新增 `PM_OPENVELA_READY_CMD=0x11` 由 mailbox
323: ISR 排入 low-power worker；`param1=1` 表示 AP 已完成 PSRAM/SMP commit，CP 只有在
324: boot stage 5、CPU1/CPU2 power、CPU2 hold、480 MHz clock 和 OpenVela PSRAM owner
325: 全部通过 readback 后才进入 stage 6 并发布 PWC ready。`param1=0` 时 `param2` 必须是
326: 真实负 errno，CP 执行 best-effort 完整 rollback。正常 recovery 的 INIT/拒绝会取消
327: shutdown 并恢复 boot vote；只有 FINISH 才进入 shutdown。CP 不实现 runtime DVFS/P1，
328: 也不在 recovery INIT 路径直接停止 CPU2。

332: 收不到 `0x5`。当前 AP 已拆分初始化：early serial 阶段只初始化逻辑状态、物理 MBOX
333: IRQ 和 console，`AppBringUp` 再启动 mailbox/MB-UART worker 并验证 CPU0 affinity。
334: `0x5` 也已移到 PWC callback 注册和worker就绪后。早期版本曾用PWC `0x12`替代原厂
335: power-up/heartbeat，导致基础liveness依赖UART STATE和PWC `0x5` completion；该迁移方案
336: 现已废止。AP恢复在HW_CTRL `0x10`发送原厂command 1/2，PWC仅保留`0x5`和`0x11`。

340: 第二次实板联调仍停在 stage 4，且 CP 未收到 AP IPC power-up。AP early serial 中
341: `bk7258_mb_uart_init()` 的初始化 `printf()` 发生在 idle stdio 建立前，现已移除。

257: 
258: 	while (1)
259: 	{
260: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
261: 		bk_err_t ret;
262: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
263: 
264: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
265: 		{
266: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
267: 			return;
268: 		}
269: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
270: 		ack_sending = 1;
271: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
272: 
273: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
274: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
275: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
276: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
277: 		{

279: 			ack_sending = 0;
280: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
281: 			return;
282: 		}
283: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
284: 		ack_count--;
285: 		ack_sending = 0;
286: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
287: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
288: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
289: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],

470: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
471: 		u32 reset_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
472: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
473: 		{
474: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
475: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
476: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);

478: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
479: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
480: 			{
481: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
482: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
483: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
484: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(

488: 		}

491: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(log_chnl_cb_x,
492: 				     phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]);
493: 		return;
494: 	}
495: 
496: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
497: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);

499: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;

504: 	}

517: 	}

521: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_ack_data1 = ack_ptr->data1;

523: 
524: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])

526: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
527: 		return;
528: 	}
529: 
530: 	u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
531: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY ||
532: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) ||
533: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
534: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
535: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
536: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))

538: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
539: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
540: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
541: 		return;
542: 	}
543: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
544: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
545: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
546: 
547: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
548: 
549: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
550: 	{
551: 		/* clear following header members. */
552: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
553: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
554: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
555: 
556: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
557: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
558: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
559: 	} else {
560: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
561: 	}
562:

564: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
565: 	{

568: 	}
569: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
570: 	{

573: 	}
574: 
575: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])

579: 	}

585: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */

595: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
596: 	}
597: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
598: 
599: 	return;

609: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;

611: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
612: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
613:

615: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
616: 
617: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
618: 
619: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
620: 		return;
621: 
622: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
623: 		return;
624: 
625: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
626: 		return;
627: 
628: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
629: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
630: 
631: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
632: 
633: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
634: 	{
635: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
636: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
637: 
638: 		return;
639: 	}
640: 
641: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr != NULL)
642: 	{
643: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
644: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
645: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
646: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
647: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
648: 
649: 		if (log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr(
650: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param,
651: 			(mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr) != BK_OK)
652: 			chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
653: 	}
654: 	else if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
655: 	{
656: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
657: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
658: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
659: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
660: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
661: 
662: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
663: 
664: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
665: 	}
666: 	else

668: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));

686: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
687: 		return;
688: 	}
689: 	return;
690: }

57: static void mbox0_reap_slots(u8 dst)
58: {
59: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
60: 	uint32_t fifo_count;
61: 	u32 reaped = 0;
62: 	u32 now;
63: 	u8 i;
64: 
65: 	if (mbox0_drv_get_send_count(dst, &fifo_count) != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
66: 		return;

69: 	if (fifo_count != 0)
70: 	{
71: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
72: 		return;
73: 	}
74: 
75: 	now = rtos_get_time();
76: 	if (!slots->fifo_empty_since_ms)
77: 	{
78: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = now ? now : 1;
79: 		return;
80: 	}
81: 	if ((u32)(now - slots->fifo_empty_since_ms) <
82: 		MBOX0_SLOT_QUARANTINE_MS)
83: 		return;
84: 
85: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
86: 	{
87: 		reaped += slots->cmd_used[i] != 0;
88: 		slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
89: 	}
90: 	/* The hardware FIFO contains pointers into these slots.  Once it has
91: 	 * remained empty for the quarantine interval, the peer has had ample time
92: 	 * to copy every published entry.  ACK-only AP traffic has no later command
93: 	 * fence, so retaining these slots indefinitely exhausts the pool during
94: 	 * RESET/STATE/PWC bring-up.
95: 	 */
96: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
97: 	{
98: 		reaped += slots->ack_used[i] != 0;
99: 		slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
100: 	}
101: 	reaped += slots->reset_used != 0;
102: 	reaped += slots->sync_used != 0;
103: 	slots->reset_used = 0;
104: 	slots->sync_used = 0;
105: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
106: 	slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
107: 	adapter_diag.tx_reaped += reaped;

409: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
410: {
411: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
412: 
413: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
414: 
415: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
416: 
417: 	if ((ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) ||
418: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
419: 	{
420: 		chnl_cb->bad_ack_count++;
421: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
422: 		return;
423: 	}
424: 
425: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
426: 
427: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
428: 	{
429: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
430: 	}
431: 	else if ((uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data1 & ~0x3u) ||
432: 		 uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data2 || uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data3)
433: 	{
434: 		tx_fail = 1;
435: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
436: 	}
437: 	else
438: 	{
439: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
440: 	}
441: 
442: 	if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
443: 	{
444: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx + chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
445: 					 sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
446: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
447: 		chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
448: 	}
449: 	else if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
450: 	{
451: 		chnl_cb->tx_fence_req = 0;
452: 		if (!chnl_cb->link_ready)
453: 		{
454: 			chnl_cb->link_ready = 1;
455: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_READY;
456: 			chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
457: 			if (bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get() ==
458: 				PM_MAILBOX_COMMUNICATION_FINISH)
459: 			{
460: 				mb_chnl_recovered(GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id));
461: 			}
462: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_READY);
463: 		}
464: 	}
465: 
466: 	if (tx_fail)
467: 	{
468: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
469: 		{
470: 			if (chnl_cb->tx_retry)
471: 			{
472: 				chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
473: 						      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
474: 						     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
475: 				chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
476: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
477: 			}
478: 			else
479: 			{
480: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 1;
481: 			}
482: 		}
483: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
484: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
485: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;
486: 		if (chnl_cb->probe_count < MB_UART_PROBE_MAX)
487: 		{
488: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
489: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() + MB_UART_PROBE_RETRY_MS;
490: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
491: 		}
492: 		else
493: 		{
494: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
495: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
496: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() +
497: 				MB_UART_DOWN_RETRY_MS;
498: 		}
499: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
500: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
501: 			chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
502: 		return;
503: 	}
504: 
505: 	/* try next Tx. */
506: 
507: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
508: 
509: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
510: 	{
511: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
512: 		if (ret_val == BK_OK)
513: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
514: 	}
515: 	if (ret_val != BK_OK)
516: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);

518: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
519: 	{
520: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
521: 	}
522: 
523: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
524: 	{
525: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
526: 	}
527: 
528: 	return;
529: }
